_about: Whole documents. `valid` must load; each `invalid` entry must be refused by the Engine with an error mentioning `error`. Entries with "client": true must also be refused by both clients' own checks (contract compatibility and structure), since a client cannot assume every server validated what it sends.

valid.name: media-blocks
valid._why: 1.2: an image and a media-list, both loaded from the Satellite's own routes.

valid.name: media-grid-tiles
valid._why: 1.2: folder tiles - an item's icon drawn when it has no image, and a tile action chosen per item: the first `open` entry whose `visible` holds (one tile opens the Satellite's own interface, the others a page).

valid.name: media-grid-quick
valid._why: 1.2: a quick action on each tile - the first entry whose `visible` holds is a small button in the tile's corner (a heart that adds, or the active heart that removes), beside the viewer.

valid.name: file-actions
valid._why: 1.2: download and share - the client fetches the Satellite's own route with its session, then saves the file or hands it to the system share sheet, named from the item.

valid.name: media-grid
valid._why: 1.2: a gallery of images and videos from the Satellite's own routes, grouped, with the shared viewer and selection; a preview document, so a client with the Satellite's own interface keeps it.

valid.name: search-and-map
valid._why: 1.2: a search field and a filter set page state, which the source route is templated with; results in a media-grid, and located items on a map that opens the shared viewer.

valid.name: paged-grid-and-viewport-map
valid._why: 1.2: a media-grid that loads its next page from the provider's cursor, and a map that loads what is on screen (items or the provider's own clusters).

valid.name: pick-action
valid._why: 1.2: the client's media picker chooses from whichever Satellite provides media.gallery, then the action's route gets the references as $value.

valid.name: own-action
valid._why: 1.2: a control opens the Satellite's own interface (its page.js, its native screens) at a section, for what stays native; a client without one hides it.

valid.name: offline-page
valid._why: 1.2: a page the client may keep to show while StarCore can't be reached - its data and a grid's loaded pages.

valid.name: secure-action
valid._why: 1.2: a viewer's and a selection's action moving the items into whichever Satellite provides media.vault, behind the client's own unlock prompt; the document names no route, prompt or PIN field.

valid.name: offline-page-with-a-choice
valid._why: 1.2: an offline page whose source depends on a choice's state: a handful of fixed values, so the client keeps one collection per value (a search's free text is still never kept).

valid.name: offline-page-omitting-fields
valid._why: 1.2: the client keeps only what the page binds, and never a field named in omit, at any depth.

valid.name: play-action
valid._why: 1.2: a button asks the client to play what the audio.library provider finds; it needs the media.audio client capability and an audio.library provider.

valid.name: newer-minor-with-unknown-block
valid._why: A Satellite written for 1.4 still loads on an Engine and clients that know 1.0: blocks they don't know are skipped.

valid.name: requires-audio
valid._why: A document may require the media.audio client capability and an audio.library provider; a client that can't meet them says why instead of opening it.

invalid.name: media-grid-quick-empty
invalid.error: must be a list of {label, action}

invalid.name: offline-omit-an-item-key
invalid._why: a kept grid needs the field its items are keyed by and their thumbnails are reached with

invalid.name: secure-an-operation-it-may-not-ask-for
invalid._why: only the operations secure_operations lists: never one that reads or takes items out of the vault

invalid.name: secure-outside-media-actions
invalid._why: only on the items a media viewer shows or a selection holds

invalid.name: secure-with-a-route
invalid._why: it reaches no route of the document's own

invalid.name: secure-with-a-form-for-the-pin
invalid._why: the PIN is only ever typed in the client's own prompt
